annotations.title: Buy a per-GB traffic pack (spends balance)

description: SPENDS MONEY from the prepaid ipvolt balance of the credential's account. Buy one prepaid pack of GB for residential IPs and for mobile IPs from a shared pool. Two steps: (1) call without confirm: this only looks up the current price and answers the exact charge and a requestId; nothing is charged. (2) Only after the user approved that charge, call again with confirm: true and that requestId. If the price rose meanwhile the API refuses instead of charging more, and repeating a confirmed requestId returns the same order without charging again. The first call needs packId (from list_traffic or list_stock). A pack is bought under the current Terms and Refund Policy, which the dashboard asks the customer to accept at each pack purchase: confirm the pack and its price with the user first. Needs a read-write API key or an agent token that may buy, of an ipvolt account.

confirm.description: Leave out to preview the charge. Set true, with the preview requestId, only after the user approved that charge.

packId.description: Pack id from list_traffic or list_stock, for example gb:5. Required for the preview.

requestId.description: The requestId the preview returned, copied exactly. Use it only with confirm: true.
